messages:
eva: Quick note from pairing: sampleapp with hot-reload flips logging level to DEBUG and then a bunch of early requests have no request-id. Seems related to middleware re-registration order.

tom_dev: yeah saw that. nodemon restart path re-applies middlewares in a different order when dev hooks run. OTEL auto-hook runs on module init, our reqid middleware is registered later in index.js after some dynamic imports.

nisha: Is this only Node? We had a Go customer say their request-id format (hex32) gets redacted by default scrubbing rules because redactor assumes UUID pattern.

sam_sre: Two separate-but-related problems: (1) init ordering in Node causes missing reqids for first few requests after reload/cold-start, (2) redaction heuristics are aggressive and mismatch SDK id formats. Both make debugging harder.

ops-bot: Created ticket INT-4598: hot-reload-request-id-loss + redaction-mismatch. Priority P3.

tom_dev: Minimal repro (Node):
```
// index.js
import './telemetry-async-init';
const app = express();
app.use(otelAutoHook()); // if telemetry finished early, this is fine
app.use(reqIdMiddleware()); // currently added after dynamic imports
app.get('/ping', (req,res)=>{ logger.info('ping'); res.send(200); });
```

// telemetry-async-init.js
setImmediate(async ()=>{ await initSdk(); logger.debug('telemetry ready'); });

tom_dev: Because init runs after app setup, otelAutoHook may attach lazily and reqIdMiddleware sometimes executes before context binding.

nisha: For Go: req IDs are 32-char hex string. Our redactor has a UUID regex first and then generic hex regex that strips tokens that look like ids. We should whitelist header names (X-Request-Id) and also run normalizers before redactor.

jorge: Proposed fixes:
 - Node sampleapp: change example to sync init in quickstart or show early minimal reqid generator middleware as fallback.
 - Docs: add note about hot-reload and dev tooling for Node.
 - Redactor: add preserve-list config and move normalizer earlier in pipeline.
 - SDK parity: add tests that validate request-id format across Node, Python, Go and ensure redaction rules preserve them.

sam_sre: Also want a metric: count of logs emitted without request_id per process boot. We'll add to sampleapp. If >0 we alert.

tom_dev: I'll open PR with: early-fallback-reqid middleware + metric + README update. Will also change quickstart snippet to show both sync and async init patterns with a warning.

nisha: I'll adjust redactor config and add a small policy: preserve header-named ids and run normalizer before scrubbing. Also update regex list so hex32 isn't categorized as sensitive by default.

eva: Can we add a tiny e2e test that uses nodemon/hotreload simulation? Maybe spin up server, then simulate reload by re-registering middlewares and assert first request had a request_id. Maria from QA can help.

sam_sre: Good call. Also add a note in troubleshooting: "If you see missing request ids after restart, check order of telemetry init vs reqid middleware; use early fallback or block init if you need strict correlation."

tom_dev: Draft logs we'll use in QA:
```
2026-03-22T09:10:01Z INFO server starting
2026-03-22T09:10:01Z DEBUG telemetry init scheduled
2026-03-22T09:10:01Z INFO http: GET /ping { message: 'start' }
2026-03-22T09:10:01Z DEBUG telemetry ready
2026-03-22T09:10:01Z INFO http: GET /ping { request_id: 'a3f5b2c4d6e8f01234567890abcdef12', message: 'after' }
```

jorge: Nice. Timeline?

tom_dev: I'll aim for PR today (early-fallback + docs), nisha will ship redactor tweak tomorrow, qa e2e next week. Canary after docs update.

eva: thanks all. tagging @tom_dev @nisha @sam_sre. adding follow-up notes to INT-4598 once PRs land. :rocket:
